ALMU is an early-stage speculative shadow candidate for US-based InP photonic components and wafer-scale photonics; direct AI optical-interconnect revenue must be verified.

Need primary-source confirmation for global InP substrate market share, Sumitomo/JX capacity, refined indium supply concentration, and whether US-listed downstream optical companies face substrate shortages versus device-fab, packaging, or demand constraints.

InP chokepoint mapping should distinguish four layers: raw/refined indium, InP substrates, InP epitaxy/device wafers/lasers, and optical-engine/transceiver integration. AXTI maps to substrates; COHR maps to device fabs/lasers; POET and ALMU map to photonic integration or component development.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the InP wafer and optical-interconnect substrate chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. The reference lane is represented by Coherent as a vertically integrated InP photonics leader. The underfollowed lane centers on AXT as the most direct US-listed InP substrate exposure, plus POET and Aeluma as speculative second-order photonics/platform beneficiaries whose exposure depends on whether InP laser, epitaxy, or wafer-level integration shortages become binding. Lumentum is a relevant omitted reference name because its InP laser exposure is clear, but its current market-cap and attention profile make it less aligned with this underfollowed pass than COHR plus smaller discovery candidates.
